# Vetrina Toscana

> > Official showcase of Tuscan gastronomy, culture, and tourism, promoting regional food products, wine, culinary events, and authentic experiences across Tuscany.

Vetrina Toscana is the regional platform dedicated to promoting Tuscan culinary excellence, featuring DOP/IGP products like Pecorino Toscano and extra virgin olive oil, wine tastings, gastronomic events, student culinary programs, and cultural heritage. The site connects visitors with authentic Tuscan food and wine experiences, from coastal islands to historic villages.

## Key Topics

- Tuscan gastronomy and culinary traditions
- DOP and IGP certified products (Pecorino Toscano, olive oil)
- Wine tourism and tastings
- Gastronomic events and competitions
- Culinary education and student programs
- Tuscan coast and islands tourism
- Historic villages and wineries (Borghi e Cantine)
- Regional food and wine excellence
- Cultural heritage and restoration
- Charity galas and food events
- Pastry competitions (Dulcis in Primis)
- Traditional Tuscan recipes
- Tourism promotion and partnerships

## Gastronomic Events & Competitions

- [Dulcis in Primis, a Montecatini Terme la sfida finale a colpi di frolla e chantilly](https://www.vetrina.toscana.it/dulcis-in-primis-a-montecatini-la-sfida-finale-a-colpi-di-frolla-e-chantilly): Dulcis in Primis pastry competition final at Montecatini Terme
- [Cena di Gala, l'evento di beneficenza firmato da La Toscana in Bocca](https://www.vetrina.toscana.it/cena-di-gala-la-toscana-in-bocca): La Toscana in Bocca charity gala dinner event at Toscana Fair
- [Afternoon tea in perfetto stile inglese con gli studenti dell'ISI Marconi di Viareggio](https://www.vetrina.toscana.it/a-tea-not-for-two-con-i-ragazzi-dellistituto-marconi): ISI Marconi Viareggio students host English-style afternoon tea event

## Wine & Olive Oil

- [Degustazione Globale con Antonio Galloni per presentare le nuove annate](https://www.vetrina.toscana.it/degustazione-globale-con-antonio-galloni): Antonio Galloni hosts global wine tasting for new Tuscan vintages
- [Selezione Oli Extra Vergine di Oliva della Toscana: aperte le iscrizioni](https://www.vetrina.toscana.it/selezione-oli-extra-vergine-di-oliva-della-toscana-aperte-le-iscrizioni): Tuscany DOP/IGP extra virgin olive oil selection opens registration

## Tourism & Cultural Routes

- [Lonely Planet sceglie per il suo live tour la costa e le isole toscane](https://www.vetrina.toscana.it/lonely-planet-sceglie-per-il-suo-live-tour-la-costa-e-le-isole-toscane): Lonely Planet features Tuscan coast and islands in Italia on the road tour
- [Tra Borghi e Cantine torna su "I sentieri del gusto"](https://www.vetrina.toscana.it/tra-borghi-e-cantine-torna-su-i-sentieri-del-gusto): Tra Borghi e Cantine returns on I sentieri del gusto program
- [Cappella della Madonna di Vitaleta, iniziati i lavori di restauro](https://www.vetrina.toscana.it/cappella-della-madonna-di-vitaleta-iniziati-i-lavori-di-restauro): Cappella della Madonna di Vitaleta restoration work begins in Tuscany

## Traditional Products & Recipes

- [Pecorino Toscano DOP: 7 video ricette per un Natale Made in Italy](https://www.vetrina.toscana.it/pecorino-toscano-dop-7-video-ricette-per-un-natale-made-in-italy): Seven Pecorino Toscano DOP video recipes for Italian Christmas meals
